rows.label: Same-Safe
rows.description:
If another pile's top card matches this rank → Safe
If no pile's top card matches this rank → Sticker becomes cursed

rows.outcomeDetail: conditional: carrier safe on a matched bet
rows.label: Guard
rows.description:
If another pile's top card matches this card's suit → this card is safe when it lands.
If none does → this sticker becomes a curse

rows.label: Payout
rows.description:
At deal end if this card tops its pile → earn coins equal to pile size.
Any card played on top of this card is cursed

rows.label: Bonus Coin
rows.description:
If another pile's top card matches this card's suit → +1 coin per pile whose top card matches.
If none does → this sticker becomes a curse

rows.label: Anchor
rows.description:
At deal end if this card tops its pile → exclude the pile from the smallest-pile score.
Any card played on top of this card is cursed

rows.label: Heavy
rows.description:
If another pile's top card matches this card's suit → +1 pile size to every pile whose top matches, including this one.
If none does → this sticker becomes a curse

rows.label: Donate
rows.description:
If another pile's top card matches this card's suit → make all pile sizes equal.
If none does → this sticker becomes a curse

rows.label: Quick Bury
rows.description:
If another pile's top card matches this card's suit → bury 1 card under this pile.
If none does → this sticker becomes a curse

rows.outcomeDetail: if a rank twin is up
rows.label: Twin Spark
rows.description: Peek at the next card if another pile's top card matches this rank

rows.label: Pillar Scout
rows.description:
If this column has no Pillar → peek at the next card.
If it has one → this sticker becomes a curse

rows.label: Base Scout
rows.description:
If this column has no Base → peek at the next card.
If it has one → this sticker becomes a curse

rows.label: Ripple
rows.description:
If another pile's top card matches this card's suit → optionally shuffle those piles.
If none does → this sticker becomes a curse

rows.label: Tell
rows.description:
If another pile's top card matches this card's suit → this card shows a tell (higher, lower, or same) for the next draw.
If none does → this sticker becomes a curse

rows.label: Recharge Shield
rows.description: Charge the Same Shield

rows.label: Tap Power
rows.description: Fire your Same-Power

rows.label: Heart Bonus
rows.description: When a ♥ lands in this column → +1 coin

rows.label: Column Tie-Safe
rows.description: Any tie is safe in this column

rows.label: Last Licks
rows.description: At deal end → +3 coins if no pile in this column survived

rows.label: Guardian
rows.description: At deal end → +4 coins if every pile in this column survived

rows.label: Clean Bury
rows.description: When a ♣ with no stickers lands in this column → bury 1 card under that pile

rows.label: All Hearts
rows.description: At deal end → +4 coins if every surviving pile in this column has a ♥ top card

rows.label: Envy
rows.description: At deal end → +2 coins per pile in this column with a ♥ top card

rows.label: Streak Size
rows.description: From the 3rd consecutive correct guess in this column → +1 pile size per guess. Resets on a wrong guess or any guess in another column

rows.label: Streak Bury
rows.description: From the 4th consecutive correct guess in this column → bury 1 card per guess. Resets on a wrong guess or any guess in another column

rows.label: Fourth Seat
rows.description: This column starts the deal with 1 extra pile (up to 4)

rows.outcomeDetail: chance to save a dying pile
rows.label: Second Wind
rows.description: Each pile that dies in this column has a 25% chance to be saved, but all the buried cards return to the deck

rows.label: Greedy
rows.description: At deal end → +4 coins if this is the only equipped pillar

rows.label: Highest Heart
rows.description: At deal end → earn coins equal to the highest numbered ♥ top card in this column (2–10 face value, Ace pays 1, royals pay 0)

rows.label: Dense Bury
rows.description: When a ♣ with 3+ stickers lands correctly in this column → bury 1 card under that pile

rows.label: Revive
rows.description: When a pile in this column reaches 10 cards → revive one dead pile

rows.label: Bulk Rate
rows.description: The store's Purge price climbs by 1 instead of 2. No effect during deal

rows.label: Freebie
rows.description: One random item in every store costs 0 coins. No effect during deal

rows.label: Rare Hunter
rows.description: Rare items appear in the store twice as often. No effect during deal

rows.outcomeDetail: wards off a Just a Two

rows.description: 30% chance to turn away a Just a Two mystery. 100% chance if there are no 2s in your deck. No effect during deal

rows.description: +30% chance to find a Beheaded Queen at a mystery stop. 100% chance if Queens are the most common rank in your deck (ties don't count). No effect during deal

rows.label: Flypaper

rows.label: Crowd Favorite
rows.description: When a {rank} lands correctly in this column → +2 coins

rows.label: Insurance

rows.label: Ditto
rows.description: Mirrors the center column's pillar

rows.label: Massive Diamond

rows.label: Prime

rows.label: Excavator

rows.label: Gambler

rows.label: Last Rites
rows.description: When a pile in this column dies → peek the next card

rows.description: When a ♠ lands in this column → 50% chance to peek at the next card

rows.description: Aces count as high or low in this column

rows.description: When a ♥ lands in this column → +2 coins per rank with zero copies in your full deck

rows.label: Empty Ranks Heavy

rows.description: If 8s are the most common rank in your full deck → this column's piles start at pile size 8

rows.description: If your full deck contains no 2s → royals (J/Q/K) are always safe in this column

rows.label: Royal Pair
rows.description: A royal landing on a royal survives a Same call in this column. A survived Same counts as a full correct Same — charges the Same Shield and fires your Same-Power

rows.label: Perfect Ten
rows.description: Ranks summing to 10 survive a Same call in this column. A survived Same counts as a full correct Same — charges the Same Shield and fires your Same-Power

rows.label: Rank Shield

rows.label: Scarce Suit

rows.description: On purchase → the store's Purge price is halved (minimum 5). No effect during deal
